exposure: fetal left pulmonary artery-left atrial fistula with aplasia of the left lung
cohort: A single fetus diagnosed with severe cardiomegaly and left pulmonary artery-left atrial fistula with left lung aplasia.
finding: Successful postnatal transcatheter closure of a rare fetal left pulmonary artery-left atrial fistula with left lung aplasia resulted in normal growth and development without pulmonary hypertension during a 15-month follow-up.
mod_finding: The baby was born by caesarean section.
